description: Returns the member's event feed for the last 7 days, newest first (limit 1 to 200): post.published, post.failed, reply.sent, patrol.reply, patrol.pending, token.expiring, usage.threshold, approval.decided. since (ISO 8601) returns only newer events; types filters by name. Applies when the user asks what happened recently or whether a post went out.
name: list_events
title: List recent events
